name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 59 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 33 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2026-02-02, at wavelengths from 1.23 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
